prompts.golf: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production sprite atlas for Street of Saranfou beat-em-up. Reference image is Karonux identity/style only: brown swept hair, black sunglasses, dark leather jacket grey hoodie jeans. ONE 4-column by 4-row exact regular grid, 16 isolated full sprites on genuinely transparent background, no checkerboard no labels, generous empty gutters. 1536 square. Crisp detailed 16-bit arcade pixel art, side view with slight top visible. WHITE Volkswagen Golf IV with Karonux visibly driving, complete combined vehicle+driver each cell. Rows 1-2 stock white Golf, rows 3-4 ultimate tuned white Golf GTI with sporty bumpers large wheels red trim. Each two-row set 8 frames in order: side facing right idle, side driving right suspension down, three-quarter front turning, three-quarter rear turning, rearward impact facing right with red taillights, broad handbrake skid facing front-left, handbrake skid rear-right, door open Karonux exiting. Same scale and consistent car geometry, all wheels fit cells, no scenery. Right facing car orientation for first two frames. Keep identity and arcade visual style from reference.
prompts.ice: Use case: stylized-concept. Game sprite atlas for Street of Saranfou. Reference is identity and arcade style: Karonux brown swept hair black sunglasses, leather jacket hoodie jeans. Transform SAME character into ice queen, frosted hair icy clothing blue aura. Genuine transparent background no checkerboard no text. Exact 4x4 grid, 16 separate full-body sprites, generous gutters, identical scale, facing right, crisp 16-bit pixel art. First two rows base ice transformation, last two rows ultimate queen with crystal crown and short flowing icy cape, recognizable same face sunglasses. Each variant 8 poses in reading order: idle guard; walking stride; fist cold punch windup; extended cold punch; heavy ice-shattering kick; low sliding dodge leaving short ice trail; arms spreading blizzard; transformation release arms raised. All complete feet effects and crown inside individual cells, centered horizontally bottom aligned, no scenery.

Each variant eight poses reading order: resting on crutches; awkward walking stride; left crutch swing; right crutch swing; charged forward cast kick; pole-vault airborne using crutch; spinning both crutches out horizontally; spectacular fall seated on floor cast outstretched with dust shockwave. prompts.fx: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent game VFX sprite atlas for 16-bit arcade beat em up Street of Saranfou. EXACT 4 columns 4 rows grid equal sized cells, generous 15% gutters, no text no checkerboard no scenery. Each row is an animation 4 progressive frames left to right. Row1 blue-white icy hit/shatter burst expands from small star into large crystal shards then dissolves. Row2 translucent blue ice prison hollow cocoon encasing a standing human sized empty silhouette progresses thin frost to full crystal prison and cracking. Row3 low horizontal frosty slippery ground patch blooms expands sparkles then fades. Row4 pale tan-white circular ground shockwave with dust and tiny asphalt chunks starts tight then expands then dissipates. Same arcade crisp outlined pixel art as supplied reference, isolated effects only no characters. True alpha transparency, do not place a human inside ice shell, frames fully contained.
